question: What is the true nature of freedom when it is closely examined?
premises: Freedom is nothing other than consciousness.
When freedom is examined carefully, it does not remain a single abstract notion.
Its expression culminates in many powers.
inference: Therefore freedom is consciousness itself appearing as many powers.
uncertainties: The relation between unity of consciousness and plurality of powers is stated compactly and may invite further doctrinal unpacking.
plain_english: So this freedom is really just consciousness. When you examine it closely, it shows itself as many different powers.
